verdict.rationale: Epic documents several official command-line surfaces. These include headless commandlets such as `UnrealEditor.exe <uproject> -run=cook -targetplatform=...`, the Unreal Automation Tool for scripted build, test, cook, package, deploy and run pipelines, Unreal Build Tool, and engine launch arguments. A probe confirms the UAT/automation CLI docs are fetchable keylessly by agents. These are traditional build and automation CLIs rather than an agent-oriented tool. Missing for 10: machine-readable/JSON output or agent-friendly ergonomics, a unified single CLI entry point, independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.
